description: Stage-3 focus: production-grade gate hardening, runtime variable control, D-class safety evidence, commissioning playbook unification, and VS Code developer-experience uplift.

userStories.title: Harden CI gates for newly delivered runtime/dev features
userStories.description: As a release owner, I want the latest online-force/retain/scenario-asset/new-scaffold capabilities to be enforced by CI gates so regressions are blocked before merge.
acceptanceCriteria: CI includes explicit gate coverage for `online_force_control_plane`, `retain_persistent`, `scenario_gen`, `sim_regress`, and `new_scaffold` contracts
Pipeline fails when `scenario-gen` summary or `sim-regress` feedback schema contracts drift
Runbook docs include exact local reproduction commands for each new gate
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: P0-1 already complete; this story is P0-2 gate hardening.

userStories.title: Add runtime online variable control plane (dev mode) with full audit
userStories.description: As a commissioning engineer, I want to set/clear runtime variables (not only IO) in dev mode so I can diagnose logic paths faster with a traceable audit trail.
acceptanceCriteria: Introduce a development-only online variable control plane with explicit enable guard (default disabled)
Support set/clear operations for at least BOOL and REAL variable types
Provide deterministic replay path via script input and aligned tick semantics
Emit audit records containing actor/source/time/variable/from/to/operation
Document safety boundaries against production/hardware paths
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Deliver abnormal-exit Class-D electrical evidence workflow
userStories.description: As a safety engineer, I want Class-D (hardware-chain) evidence to be standardized and auditable so manual safety validation can be reviewed consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: Define Class-D electrical test checklist template with required fields (trigger, wiring state, measured result, verdict, operator)
Extend abnormal-exit evidence schema/verifier to ingest and validate Class-D evidence attachments as manual-hardware artifacts
Publish documentation linking Class-D procedure to existing abnormal-exit matrix and board safety notes
Add regression tests for schema/verifier behavior on valid/invalid Class-D evidence
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Unify commissioning playbook across doctor/force/retain/gate
userStories.description: As a field engineer, I want one commissioning playbook that chains diagnostics, online force, retain restore, and gate checks so rehearsals are repeatable and low-friction.
acceptanceCriteria: Provide a single end-to-end commissioning playbook from scenario diagnostics to final no-board gate
Include at least two runnable rehearsal flows: nominal startup and fault-injection/debug
Playbook specifies exact artifact locations and pass/fail checkpoints for each step
Add doc consistency tests to lock required command snippets and key headings
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Upgrade VS Code support from minimal tasks to practical day-1 workflow
userStories.description: As a new developer, I want stronger VS Code support so I can edit PLC files, run common flows, and troubleshoot without manual setup overhead.
acceptanceCriteria: Define VS Code support package contract (syntax association/highlight strategy, snippets or command tasks, recommendations)
Ensure `rust_plc new` emits the upgraded VS Code assets by default
Add onboarding documentation for install/use and common troubleshooting
Add integration tests asserting scaffolded VS Code assets and key command entries
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
